ValidationRule.description: Commercial terms cannot change once the quote is submitted, unless the user holds Sales_Override_Quote_Lock.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(NOT(ISNEW()), OR(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), 'Pending Approval'), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), 'Approved'), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), 'Ordered')), OR(ISCHANGED(Opportunity__c), ISCHANGED(Price_Book__c), ISCHANGED(Term_Months__c), ISCHANGED(Valid_Until__c)), NOT($Permission.Sales_Override_Quote_Lock))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Opportunity, price book, term and expiry cannot change after submission. Recall the quote first.
